selection: For Shihe and Hangbuhe, three new candidate objects in each of 0.2-1, 1-3, and 3-5 ha were sampled separately from future-supported and no-future-support groups.
limits: Mechanism-stratified samples do not estimate population accuracy.
Future absence can reflect drying or sensor/model differences, not only false positives.
Future persistence can repeat stable errors and is not field truth.
No object is restored and no DEM volume or production output is changed.
